serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Welcome back {f_playerName}. In your absence, I took the liberty of conducting maintenance on the stove you brought home.
You: Right, thanks. I almost forgot that I asked you to take a look. Is it working properly? I would feel like an idiot if the Landlord bamboozled me. 
Bot: There were some minor problems, but right now it is in an operational state.
Bot: The stove is so old that there were no schematics available on the internet. I had to figure out everything on my own.
Damn, she put a lot of work to it. I feel kinda bad giving her such a difficult task.
You: Thank you very much for repairing it! I would be in deep trouble without you.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: No problem! I’m happy to be of help!
Bot: I also increased the efficiency by 15% and put some modern safety mechanisms like temperature limiter, automatic shut-off timer and a circuit breaker!
You: That’s actually impressive!
Bot: Thanks to these changes it’s almost as good as the cheapest new stove available in the nearby store!
You: …
You: Could you remind me how much is it for that new stove?
Bot: It’s around 220$
Uff… 20$ is not much, but it’s better than nothing. For a second I thought that I got played by the Landlord.
